notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed broken file dialog on the main menu
- Player no longer stay in the security cameras when attacked

notes.title: v1.2 'The Make-A-Mafia' update out now!
notes.notes:
To celebrate 1 year since release of One Week With The Mafia, I decided to uplift the game into what I now consider to be a more 'finished' state.

Additions:

- Custom Mafias/Modding : With the new mod editor, you can now replace any and all of the intruders' sprites with absolutely any .png image! 

- Huge difficulty overhaul : This was by far the most requesting change. Overall, power consumption has been pretty much halved or more depending on the night. Intruders also spend less time at you door.

- Rewritten and rerecorded telephone audio.

- Certain parts of the game have been given major performance boosts (Specifically, the main menu)
